items.description: Ukrainian drone-interceptor crews are working around the clock to stop Russian reconnaissance and attack drones approaching the frontline city of Kramatorsk. RFE/RL spent a night with one team defending the skies as aerial attacks intensify.

items.title: Ukraine’s New Military Commander Maj. Gen. Mykhailo Drapaty: 5 Things to Know
items.description: Mykhailo Drapaty, Ukraine’s new senior officer, is renowned for frontline leadership since 2014. He pioneered large-scale drone-centric warfare, helped liberate Kherson, and is respected for decentralized command, innovation, and accepting responsibility for battlefield failures.
